prompt: A service log lives at /workspace/app.log. Find the timestamp of the first ERROR event that occurs before an event containing 'connection refused', and write exactly that timestamp on a single line to /workspace/answer.txt.

environment_files.app.log:
2024-04-01T12:33:00 INFO server started on port 8080
2024-04-01T12:34:56 ERROR failed to parse header from upstream
2024-04-01T12:35:10 WARN retry scheduled for /health
2024-04-01T12:35:22 WARN retrying upstream /api/metrics
2024-04-01T12:35:45 ERROR upstream connect failed: connection refused
2024-04-01T12:36:00 INFO shutdown received

test_files.check_log.py:
import sys
expected = '2024-04-01T12:34:56'
try:
    got = open('/workspace/answer.txt').read().strip()
except FileNotFoundError:
    got = ''
sys.exit(0 if got == expected else 1)
